name: LLMHound I3: Jupyter servers with anonymous API or contents access
description: Jupyter servers where jupyter_contents or jupyter_sessions succeeded anonymously (version metadata never counts).
query:
MATCH (j:LLMHound_JupyterServer)
WHERE 'jupyter_contents' IN j.anon_operations
   OR 'jupyter_sessions' IN j.anon_operations
OPTIONAL MATCH (j)-[:LLMHound_Contains]->(f:LLMHound_WorkspaceFile)
RETURN j, f
LIMIT 500
